title: Catch-Up Payment on a Past-Due Patient Payment Plan
content:
Under **Patient Payment Plans**, a catch-up payment is the payment a patient makes to bring a past-due plan back to current standing; it is posted on the plan ledger as an arrears payment against the plan's latest missed installment.

## What the payment does
The patient pays the catch-up payment on their own past-due payment plan, with their own payment method. One payment posts one line on the plan's activity, marked as an arrears payment against the installment named; it lowers the plan's remaining balance by the amount paid and returns the plan to current standing, so that the plan shows as active. The patient sees the payment on the plan straight away, together with a payment reference.

## How it is invoked
The payment is made through the customer-side tool `pay_catch_up_2a071954`. It is the patient's own act: the agent unlocks the tool for the patient with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it with their own payment method. The agent does not run it in the patient's place.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `plan_id` | The reference number of the patient's payment plan, as the payment-plan lookup shows it | Identifier |
| `installment_number` | The number of the missed installment this payment settles, copied from the missed-installment line on the plan's activity | Non-negative whole number (0 denotes the down payment) |
| `due_date` | The due date of that missed installment, copied from the same line | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `amount` | The amount the patient pays | USD, a positive number to 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent |
| `payment_method` | How the patient pays | Exactly one of the values below |

Values of `payment_method`:
- `credit_card` — the patient pays with a credit card;
- `debit_card` — the patient pays with a debit card;
- `ach_bank_transfer` — the patient pays from a checking or savings account by bank transfer;
- `check` — the patient pays by a mailed paper check;
- `hsa_fsa_card` — the patient pays with a health savings or flexible spending account card.

## Return
On success the tool returns `payment_id` (the reference of the posted payment), `plan_id`, `amount_paid` (USD to 2 decimal places), `plan_balance` (USD to 2 decimal places, the plan's remaining balance once the payment is applied) and `plan_status`, which reads "active". A returned `payment_id` means the payment was posted.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)
A patient's plan shows a missed-installment line for installment 4, due 2026-05-12. The installment number and due date passed are 4 and 2026-05-12, copied from that line; the amount is the catch-up payment in USD to the cent; the method is the one the patient pays with, for example `debit_card`. The receipt shows the payment reference, the amount paid, the remaining plan balance and the status "active".
